summary: Language/Internationalization (i18n) Feature Testing Complete. All 7 tests passed. The language selector dropdown works correctly, translations for Spanish, French, German, and Chinese are properly applied to login page and sidebar navigation, localStorage persistence works, and login functionality continues to work after language change.
passed_tests: ✅ TEST 1: Language selector dropdown appears in login page header (data-testid='language-selector')
✅ TEST 2: Language selector shows all available languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese)
✅ TEST 3: Selecting Spanish changes login page text to Spanish (Iniciar Sesión, Correo Electrónico, Contraseña)
✅ TEST 4: Selecting French changes login page text to French (Connexion, Email, Mot de Passe)
✅ TEST 5: Language preference stored in localStorage as 'medmatch-language'
✅ TEST 6: Language preference persists after page refresh
✅ TEST 7: Login functionality works correctly after language change
✅ Sidebar navigation labels translate correctly (Spanish: Panel Principal, Mi Currículum, Buscar Empleo, etc.)
✅ Sidebar navigation labels translate correctly (French: Tableau de Bord, Mon CV, Recherche d'Emploi, etc.)
✅ Chinese translations work (登录, 电子邮件, 密码)
critical_code_review_comments: i18n implementation is well-structured with I18nProvider context and useTranslation hook
All 5 bundled languages (en, es, fr, zh, de) have complete translation files
Non-bundled languages (ja, ko, pt, ar, etc.) show 'AI' badge indicating AI translation will be used
GlobalLanguageSelector component properly uses data-testid for testing
LoginPage correctly uses t() function for all translatable strings
Sidebar navigation in App.js uses labelKey pattern with t() function for translations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language/i18n feature fully tested and working. The i18n system uses: 1) I18nProvider context wrapping the app in App.js, 2) useTranslation hook for accessing t() function, 3) Bundled JSON translation files in /app/frontend/src/locales/ for en, es, fr, zh, de, 4) GlobalLanguageSelector component with data-testid='language-selector', 5) localStorage key 'medmatch-language' for persistence. All login page elements and sidebar navigation labels translate correctly when language is changed.
